rationale: First nonempty complete five-bin window in registered training source-day index 1, anchored to original audited observation origin. Three source-days chosen in chronological order without outcome or held-out selection. Five minutes equals the longest existing measured history scale and allows observed ~14-second rewrite effects and resulting layouts to persist over substantially more arrivals than the prior one-minute screen. Preserve every arrival, original spacing and declared template mix. This remains a controlled overloaded regime if the measured one-client service cannot keep up; no thinning/compression or resource-profile SQL inference. Three windows expand demand identities; they do not guarantee independent host/cache outcomes or model power.
limitations: One training warehouse/minute and imposed benchmark SQL mix cannot establish original Snowflake workload reproduction.
This export is a schedule, not observed offered/dispatch/completion evidence.
A single-client baseline queue diagnostic is not a cost-training or common-horizon action comparison.
